name: pi-incremental-py
description: An incremental Python kernel for pi: a persistent namespace where cells form a static dependency graph (symtable-derived) and edits recompute the minimum of the heap.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../shared/typecheck install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npm --prefix ../shared/test/tui install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && node ../shared/typecheck/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json

author: Marco Zocca
